answer: Each epoch the grove publishes every ballot and scores the wander between each pair of seats as the share of votes on which they split. A seat locks 10 tundra, plus 10 for every other seat whose wander from it stays under 5%. An honest voter locks about 10. An operator's k lockstep clones lock 10k each, 10k² tundra in total, so his k-th clone costs 10(2k−1) more tundra because it raises every sibling's bond too. Twenty clones lock 4,000 tundra. Cutting that bill means letting the clones vote apart, which gives up the bloc he built them for.
